## Welcome

Hello and welcome! I am **Matteo Aldovardi**, a mathematician and machine learning practitioner with a background in harmonic analysis, operator theory, and 3D computer vision.

This site serves as an open portfolio and knowledge hub where I share:
- [**Portfolio**](portfolio.qmd): Industry projects (such as 3D aerial scene reconstruction at Leonardo Velivoli), pure math research publications, and machine learning implementations.
- [**Blog**](blog/index.qmd): In-depth tutorials and code implementations in machine learning, mathematical modeling, and data science.
- [**About Me**](about.qmd): Academic journey, technical background, and downloadable CV.
